name: Himalayan Wildlife Predator Portrait
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Show cold high-altitude texture: frost crystals crusting whiskers, dense silver-spotted winter coat rising over slate scree ridge, alert amber iris intensity at `500mm f/4`.

name: Golden-Hour Equine Power & Dust
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Backlight muscular sheen cleanly: backlit golden dust clouds billowing beneath flying hooves, wind-whipped mane strands glowing orange against deep dusk meadow hills.

name: Tracked Milky Way & Alpine Silhouette
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `14mm f/1.4 star-tracker exposure`: crisp pinpoint stars, dusty amber galactic core nebula arching above silhouetted mountain tent glowing gently inside with warm amber lantern.

name: Modern Biophilic Stone & Bamboo Villa
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Combine dark charred cedar slats (`shou sugi ban`), quiet black basalt reflecting pool, morning courtyard mist threading emerald bamboo stalks, and soft shoji glow.

name: Midnight Rainy Convenience Store Glow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Capture peaceful `3:00 AM urban solitude`: crisp fluorescent aisle glow pouring out rain-spattered glass doors onto glistening crosswalk stripes, lone umbrella figure reading phone outside.

name: Warm Analog Vinyl & Tube-Amp Sanctuary
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Stage glowing orange vacuum-tube amplifier filaments, walnut veneer Horn speakers, densely packed LP spines under warm amber reading lamp on rainy twilight evening.

name: Michelin Chiaroscuro Culinary Macro
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Isolate artisanal stoneware plate with tight flagged softbox overhead: glistening herb oil droplets, crisp char texture, micro-greens standing crisp against dark moody slate bistro background.

name: Specialty Espresso Extraction & Steam
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Focus `50mm f/1.8 macro` tightly on tiger-striped golden crema streaming from naked portafilter above brushed stainless tray alongside warm backlit espresso steam curls.

name: Swiss Mechanical Watch Bevel Macro
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `100mm macro commercial watch light`: crisp polished chamfered steel bevels catching clean white studio strip gradient, blued steel hands, tiny radial guilloche dial engraving.

name: Backlit Crystal Bottle & Caustic Halo
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Backlight cut amber crystal through frosted glass scrim resting over dark wet obsidian slate, throwing sharp golden refractive caustic arcs across foreground surface.

name: Minimalist Plaster Staircase Sun Slice
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame razor-clean geometric architecture (`travertine or warm chalk plaster`), letting harsh crisp diagonal afternoon window sun split textured frame strictly into sunlit gold and cool slate.

name: Atmospheric Subway Tile & Blur
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Balance gritty glazed mosaic tiles under cool platform fluorescents, passing train motion streak on yellow safety line, and calm solitary traveler waiting with scarf.

name: Sun-Bleached Amalfi Stone Terrace
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Show sunlit limestone balustrade framing deep cobalt Tyrrhenian cove, heavy earthenware lemon pots, striped linen shade, and warm dusty golden-hour salt haze.

name: Moody Scottish Highlands Stone Cabin
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor weathered dark fieldstone cottage with faint peat smoke curling from chimney beneath brooding bruised rainclouds above winding silver glen stream and rust-colored bracken.

name: High-Altitude Refuge Lantern Under Stars
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Contrast frigid cobalt-blue snow-packed couloir under bright stars with one tiny inviting warm orange window square perched firmly upon steep granite col.

name: Tactile Hardware & Soldering Bench
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Stage illuminated stereo microscope overhead green PCB traces, drifting flux rosin smoke wisp illuminated by warm task lamp, tweezers, braided cables, and scuffed aluminum tools.

name: 1970s Analog Cockpit & Horizon Dusk
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Illuminate dense row of analog circular dials softly in warm red-amber night-flight instrument glow while distant pink sunset storm tops glow cleanly through scuffed canopy plexiglass.

name: Ruined Glass Conservatory & Ferns
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Filter soft shafts of humid forest daylight through shattered wrought-iron skylights down across moss-carpeted cracked marble tiles and wild spiraling ferns.

name: Overcast Cedar Temple Courtyard Rain
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use quiet soft overcast light over wet dark cedar engawa veranda, raked gray gravel wet with dark rain drops, mossy lantern, and pale pink cherry blossoms resting on stone.

name: Labyrinthine Antique Bookshop Warmth
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pack floor-to-ceiling leaning cedar shelves overflowing with frayed leather folios, rolling brass library ladder, warm dusty afternoon beam catching floating specks over oak ladder.

name: Supersonic Fighter Runway Twilight
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Mirror glowing violet-amber afterburner shock diamonds across slick rain-drenched concrete runway while heat shimmer blurs misty pine treeline at base perimeter.

name: F1 Wet-Track Pit Lane Spray
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Capture glistening carbon-fiber aero bargeboards, green-banded wet treads blasting fine mist rooster tails under floodlit twilight stadium gantry haze.

name: Crisp Archival Herbarium Specimen
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame top-down 90° flatlay over warm archival cotton rag paper highlighting translucent dried leaf venation, delicate linen tape mounts, and crisp fine-nib ink specimen notes.

name: Heavy Steel Foundry Crucible Pour
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Flood vast smoky steel rafters cleanly with blinding white-orange molten slag stream arcing downward into casting mold as silhouetted workers shield silver reflective suits.

name: Arctic Red Hull Icebreaker Pack Ice
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Show massive rust-streaked crimson steel bow splitting fractured electric-blue sea ice floes beneath crisp low polar sun casting long golden streaks across frozen ocean.
